# Office of the Professions

> New York State's professional licensing and regulatory authority, protecting the public by overseeing the licensure, registration, and conduct of healthcare and other regulated professionals.

The Office of the Professions, part of the New York State Education Department, administers licensing requirements, renewal processes, and regulatory compliance for dozens of healthcare and professional occupations. The office works with the Board of Regents and State Boards for the Professions to ensure public protection and professional standards.

## Core Information

- [Office of the Professions Homepage](https://www.op.nysed.gov): Main entry point for NYS professional licensing and regulatory services
- [About the Office of the Professions](https://www.op.nysed.gov/about-office-professions): Mission statement and public protection mandate of the Office of the Professions
- [Licensed Professions in New York State](https://www.op.nysed.gov/licensed-professions-new-york-state): Overview of professional licensing and regulation across all regulated occupations

## Professional Licensing Directory

- [New York State Licensed Professions](https://www.op.nysed.gov/professions): Comprehensive directory of all licensed professions regulated by New York State
- [Licensed Professions Index](https://www.op.nysed.gov/professions-index): Indexed directory of NYS licensed professions with regulatory information and verification tools

## Regulatory Guidance & Notices

- [Advisory Notices](https://www.op.nysed.gov/node/788376): Current advisory notices and regulatory warnings from the Office of the Professions

- [Career Landing](https://www.op.nysed.gov/careers-index): Career guidance and exploration resources for New York State licensed professions
